column3: NKJV has “Last of all,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “Finally.”
NKJV includes “answered,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “Jesus said to them.”
Close to the Greek; “like angels” is rendered “equal to the angels.”
Close to the Greek; “at the bush” is rendered “in the burning bush passage.”
NKJV has “Now David himself said,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “For David himself says.”
